entities.name: Users
entities.rationale: Drawn as an icon with three user silhouettes at the top right, representing the Sanofi data scientists accessing the platform.

entities.name: CloudFront
entities.rationale: CloudFront icon at top center (AWS_Icon_11), providing distribution and TLS certification for the static web portal.

entities.name: Sanofi SSO
entities.rationale: A boxed external identity provider labeled 'SANOFI SSO' at the top left.

entities.name: Cognito
entities.rationale: Amazon Cognito icon (AWS_Icon_10) labeled 'COGNITO', managing federated user authentication with Sanofi SSO.

entities.name: S3 Static Website
entities.rationale: Amazon S3 bucket icon (AWS_Icon_8) representing the static website hosting the analytics portal.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: Amazon API Gateway icon (AWS_Icon_9) labeled 'API GATEWAY', serving the dynamic API requests for the portal.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Amazon DynamoDB icon (AWS_Icon_7) labeled 'DYNAMO DB', storing user metadata and audit/traceability logs.

entities.name: Service Catalog
entities.rationale: AWS Service Catalog icon (AWS_Icon_5) labeled 'SERVICE CATALOG', managing standardized product provisioning.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda icon (AWS_Icon_6), orchestrating calls to AWS AI/ML services.

entities.name: R Studio
entities.rationale: Compute icon (AWS_Icon_3) labeled 'R STUDIO', representing provisioned RStudio environments on AWS compute.

entities.name: SageMaker
entities.rationale: Amazon SageMaker icon (AWS_Icon_4) labeled 'SAGEMAKER', provisioned for secure data science notebooks.

entities.name: Translate
entities.rationale: Amazon Translate icon (AWS_Icon_2) labeled 'TRANSLATE', used for batch translation of text data.

entities.name: Comprehend Medical
entities.rationale: Amazon Comprehend Medical icon (AWS_Icon_1) labeled 'COMPREHEND MEDICAL', extracting entities and metadata from raw medical data.

entities.name: Data Lake
entities.rationale: S3 bucket icon at the bottom labeled 'DATA LAKE', hosting segregated enterprise data sets.

visual_connections.description: Curved arrow indicating users connect to the web application via CloudFront.
Arrow showing CloudFront routing traffic to the S3 bucket hosting static website assets.
Double-headed arrow representing SSO federation and identity exchange between Sanofi SSO and Cognito.
Horizontal double-headed arrow representing authentication flows between Cognito and the web portal.
Horizontal double-headed arrow connecting the web interface with backend dynamic API endpoints.
Horizontal double-headed arrow showing API Gateway persisting and reading user metadata and audit events in DynamoDB.
Vertical double-headed arrow representing interaction between the portal UI and AWS Service Catalog.
Diagonal arrow indicating Service Catalog provisions R Studio instances.
Diagonal arrow indicating Service Catalog provisions SageMaker notebook instances.
Vertical line/arrow indicating API Gateway invokes Lambda functions for processing.
Vertical double-headed arrow connecting Lambda with Amazon Translate.
Diagonal double-headed arrow connecting Lambda with Amazon Comprehend Medical.
